description: Cross-dataset category map for renderer-oriented Subsim hydrophone analysis.

mapping_notes.hf_wmms_parquet: Species labels are treated as direct marine mammal labels.
mapping_notes.hf_shipsear: Class index is mapped coarsely: classes 0-3 as surface vessel noise, class 4 as environmental noise.
mapping_notes.mbari_pacific_sound_2khz: No explicit per-clip labels in v1 pull; mapped as inferred ambient soundscape with possible mixed contributors.
